messages:
leo (product): starting thread to finalize the design-partner runbook + screening form. goal: clear gating & light-weight ops so we can scale cohorts without heavy manual triage.

tasha (eng-platform): thumbs. do we have a standard provisioning SLA for private vs hosted pilots?

leo (product): proposed: hosted onboarding <48h, private/VPC onboarding 5-7 business days (depends on infra allocation). will mark private as 'needs ops lead'.

kevin (sales): question: can we map pilot types to commercial tags? e.g., 'enterprise-eval' vs 'integration-check' so sales knows which to spin up.

leo (product): yes — we'll tag inbound candidates with: enterprise, integration, research, low-touch. sales can filter by tag.

nina (legal): for regulated pilots need: DPA addendum signed, data residency clause (if customer requires), and audit window. also need clarity on model IP: who owns eval prompts and derived artifacts?

leo (product): agree. add legal gating checklist item: DPA signed for any PII/reg request; IP note in SOW template.

omar (sre): monitoring/alerts: pilots should inherit platform SLOs but with relaxed thresholds. propose pilot SLOs: p95 latency < 800ms (hosted), error budget 1% for non-regulated partners. auto-escalate if error budget burn >50% in 24h.

maya (research): for quality signals, we need an eval harness & baseline prompts from partner. ask partners to run three canonical test cases and a synthetic edge-case set. we'll compute delta vs baseline (quality drop %) and flag anything > 15% drop.

kevin (sales): screening form suggestion (compact):
- Company / product name
- Pilot objective (one sentence)
- Key success metric (how they define success)
- Typical weekly traffic (calls / tokens)
- Data classification (none / pseudonymized / PII / regulated)
- Required SLAs (p95 latency)
- Integrations needed (S3, KMS, VPC peering, other)
- Willingness to run eval harness (Y/N)
- Commercial interest (yes/no/unknown)
- Preferred contact + timezone

leo (product): nice. add: 'can you share one representative prompt or input schema' to speed repro.

nina (legal): add checkbox for 'will share redacted data for debugging' + consent line.

omaR (sre): (typo fix) omar (sre): also include 'preferred maintenance window' so we can schedule reboots or migrations.

leo (product): feedback loop plan:
- Day 0: kickoff + runbook walkthrough
- Office hours: Tue & Thu 10:00-11:00 PT (drop-in for partner engineers)
- Weekly async status thread (structured): top 3 issues, recent deploys, metrics snapshot
- Bug board (kanban) with labels: bug/regression/ask/prio-high
- Monthly retrospective for rolling cohorts

maya (research): add running experiment branch: small dev branch for partner fixes, deploy to a partner-specific traffic key, expire after cohort. avoids cross-impact.

kevin (sales): escalation path when partners report business-critical outage?

omar (sre): escalation: partner severity definitions -> SEV1 (platform down for partner): page SRE -> mobilize oncall + engage product + sales rep. SEV2 (major regression): Slack ping -> 2hr SLA response -> triage. Document in runbook.

leo (product): success metrics proposal (KPIs we track):
- Pilot adoption: % of partner calls hitting new endpoint (target: >= 50% by week 3)
- SLA compliance: days with p95 under target (target: 90% of cohort days)
- Quality delta: average quality drop vs baseline (target: < 10%)
- MTTR: mean time to resolve SEV1/2 incidents (target: SEV1 < 60m, SEV2 < 8h)
- Partner satisfaction: median 5-pt Likert after week4 (target: >=4)

tasha (eng-platform): metrics tagging note: ensure traffic is labeled by partner_id + traffic_type (experiment/canary/fallback). we'll need this for dashboards.

kevin (sales): how do we prioritize partner feature requests vs bugs?

leo (product): prioritization rubric draft: score = (business impact 1-5) * (adoption probability 1-5) * reproducibility (1-3). if partner is tagged enterprise, multiply by 1.5. anything score > 40 -> product sprint triage.

maya (research): also capture 'signal fidelity' (how many reproductions, cross-partner reports) as a tiebreaker.

nina (legal): two gating items before any private data onboarding: signed DPA + security questionnaire completion. include SOC/ISO pages link.

leo (product): onboarding checklist (minimal):
- intake form completed
- legal gating cleared (if needed)
- infra provisioning scheduled (private: ops lead assigned)
- onboarding call scheduled + runbook shared
- eval harness & baseline supplied
- dashboards and read-only access created for partner

omar (sre): ops note: we need a 'deprovision' date in the SOW. auto-removal policy if partner inactive for 30 days post-cohort.

kevin (sales): timeline sanity check: outreach Tues 3524760000, close invites by Fri 3524790000, onboarding week after. ok?

leo (product): sounds fine. final action items:
- kevin: collect candidate list + intake answers (due 24h)
- tasha: implement partner tagging & dashboard stub (due EOW)
- maya: create eval harness template + small instruction doc (due 48h)
- nina: prepare DPA + redline checklist for pilots (due 48h)
- omar: add pilot SLOs and deprovision policy to runbook (due 48h)

pilot-bot: created pilot-runbook v0.3 -> drafts/pilot-runbook-v0.3.md

leo (product): thanks everyone. i'll collate into a single runbook and share for review tomorrow. if anyone has edits to scoring rubric, drop them here.

kevin (sales): will post candidate list shortly.

maya (research): adding edge-case prompt examples to the harness doc now.

nina (legal): I'll ping if any partner requests special clauses.

omar (sre): noted, will add auto-escalation playbook.

leo (product): perfect 680 (thanks)
